title: The Verdict of Saint Alder's Anew
author: Wren Kavanagh
blurb: Wren Almeida, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
